name: Full Arc start modal opens and Begin navigates to the take page

planSteps.description: Click the 'Start the Full Arc' button in the Full Arc card section
Verify a modal opens titled 'Start Full Arc' that displays '~35 min' and '131 questions'.
Click the 'Begin' button inside the modal
Verify the browser navigates to /arc/take and the progress indicator reads '1 of 131'.
